newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm on return of shipowners.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm on return of shipowners.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices on Friday were supported by the return of demand after shipowners held off their buying the whole week, traders said.
"Enquiries are much better. Shipowners who stayed away the whole week have come to a point where they have no choice but to buy," a trader said. "They are cornered to buy before the weekend."
Bunker 180 cst was firmer at $119-120 from Thursday's $117-$120, 380cst up to $116-$117.50 from $113-$116.
MDO also rose, to $200-$205 from $196-$202 and gas oil to $215-$216 from $209-$213. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086).
